zai-org/GLM-5.3.description: NeuroLink default. The model named in the code examples on the vendor's docs Get Started page (https://docs.inceptron.io), Introduction (https://docs.inceptron.io/introduction), Chat Completions API Reference (https://docs.inceptron.io/API%20Reference/chat-completions), Error Handling and Handling Streaming Responses pages, and in the Kilo Code and OpenCode config ("model": "inceptron/zai-org/GLM-5.3") on https://docs.inceptron.io/Guides/kilo-code, which states: "GLM-5.3 supports a 1M-token context window (1,048,576 tokens)". The config block on that page has "limit" set to context 1048576 and output 1048576. Models page https://www.inceptron.io/models (2026-09-29): tags text, code, tool-calling, reasoning; 1M context; quantization fp4; size 754B; input $1.40, output $4.40 and cache read $0.26 per 1M tokens. The docs Models API Reference (https://docs.inceptron.io/API%20Reference/models) lists it with Deployment Mode Serverless. Roster (unauthenticated GET https://api.inceptron.io/v1/models, 2026-09-29): context_length 1048576, max_output_length 1048576, input_modalities ["text"], supported_features chat, completion, tools, reasoning, json_mode, structured_outputs. vision is false because the roster input_modalities is ["text"].

errorRules.message: Inceptron returned HTTP 401 unauthorized. The vendor's Error Handling page (https://docs.inceptron.io/Guides/error-handling) describes 401 as: Your API key is missing, invalid, or disabled. NeuroLink reads {apiKeyEnvVar}; keys come from {setupUrl}
Inceptron returned HTTP 429. The vendor's Error Handling page (https://docs.inceptron.io/Guides/error-handling) describes 429 as: You have exceeded your rate limit.

instructions: 1. Visit: https://console.inceptron.io and sign in or sign up — the sign-in page shows Continue with Google, Continue with GitHub and Sign in with email, and links to https://console.inceptron.io/auth/signup
2. Create an API key — the Introduction page says: "After signing up, navigate to the account section of the dashboard to create an API key." (https://docs.inceptron.io/introduction)
3. Set {apiKeyEnvVar} in your .env file (the docs' examples read INCEPTRON_API_KEY)
setup.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.inceptron.io/v1 (https://docs.inceptron.io/API%20Reference/chat-completions: "Our API is compliant with OpenAI's Chat Completions API"), with the 6 models the unauthenticated GET /models roster listed on 2026-09-29 in models.catalog. An unauthenticated GET of https://api.inceptron.io/v1/chat/completions returned HTTP 401 with error.type invalid_request_error and error.code unauthorized (2026-09-29), so errorRules match status 401; the 429 rule uses the status the vendor's Error Handling page lists. pricingPerMTok is taken from the models page https://www.inceptron.io/models (2026-09-29); the pricing field in the roster response carries different values. models.defaultContextWindow (128000) and models.defaultMaxOutputTokens (16384) are NeuroLink placeholders for model ids outside models.catalog, not vendor figures; the roster max_output_length values are quoted in the models.catalog descriptions and no per-model maxOutputTokens is set. Each model's status field holds production, a placeholder for a value the catalog schema requires; it is not a vendor statement. billingPolicy no-free-tier is a schema placeholder (the schema has no unknown value), not a vendor statement. Verification level: docs- and roster-verified, not yet live-verified.

rosterVerified.method: unauthenticated GET https://api.inceptron.io/v1/models — 6 models; credential-free, no key used
